asvs.statusNote: Local fixture mapping only; not an ASVS certification.

controls.control: DOM comment content is assigned with textContent; hostile markup remains text.
No user-controlled outbound/dynamic URL exists in this fixture.
No database or query layer exists in this fixture.
The HTTP app accepts no command input; test harness invokes fixed executables and argv.
Production server/client source contains no dynamic eval or Function construction.
No server-side request or URL fetch feature exists.
No upload endpoint exists.
ZIP export path validation is covered by the repository export tests, outside the runnable fixture.
Local HTTP cookie omits Secure; production HTTPS behavior is outside this fixture.
Demo password verifier stores scrypt-derived values and compares with timingSafeEqual; demo samples do not define production parameters.
Cookie and CSRF token sentinels are redacted in success and denied request logs.
Session ID uses 256 CSPRNG bits; server remains loopback only.
No third-party or user-selected external services are used; local communication is loopback-only.
Session cookie uses SameSite=Strict; regression asserts attribute.
Session token is set only through HttpOnly Set-Cookie; regression asserts attribute.
CSP denies object content, uses base-uri none and self-only script source.
PORT from environment is parsed as an integer in 0..65535 and host is fixed to loopback.
Origin is compared to a fixed local allowlist; wildcard CORS is not used.
Responses include X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
Responses set Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.
Login and comment bodies are capped at 16 KiB; malformed JSON is answered with generic 400 and oversize bodies with generic 413.
Only request method/path and event metadata are logged; body, comment, cookie, and CSRF values are omitted.
CSRF is independently random per session and required for writes and logout; inherited username properties are rejected.
